# Merchants' Saloon

> Merchants' Saloon is a long-running, no-frills bar in Oakland with strong drinks, beers on tap and pool. Rated 4.5 from 548 Google reviews.

- Type: Bar
- Address: 401 2nd St, Oakland, CA 94607, USA
- Phone: (510) 465-8032

## About
Merchants' Saloon is a long-running bar in Oakland, offering drinks and pool in a funky, no-frills space. It's dark, the walls are covered in graffiti, and the crowd is a diverse mix of folks.
A reviewer who has been coming in for a few decades says it's almost always a good time, and if not, it'll be interesting and memorable. Another said they felt like a local, and that everyone there knew each other.
We're open early on weekdays and late every night, and we hold a 4.5 rating from 548 Google reviews.

## Services
- Drinks: Cocktails and drinks poured in a funky, no-frills space.
- Beers on tap: A reviewer called out the great beers on tap.
- Pool: Grab a drink and shoot some pool.

## FAQ
Q: What are your weekday hours?
A: Monday through Friday we're open from 7:00 AM to 2:00 AM.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: Yes. Saturday and Sunday we're open from 12:00 PM to 2:00 AM.

Q: Do you serve food?
A: Not regularly. A reviewer mentioned a food pop-up on their visit and said the food was fantastic, so it's worth keeping an eye out.

## What customers say
- "There's not food served regularly. Today there was a Pop up. The food was fantastic... I've been going to merchants for A few decades now and it's Almost always a Good Time. If not good it'll definitely be interesting and memorable. You'll Have a Story to tell.
Highly recommend this place for Authentic Oakland Fun." (Michael Brennan, 5/5)
- "I felt like a local at this nearly-hidden 104-year-old bar. Everyone there knew each other. The service was top-notch and the drink was strong. The atmosphere is like none other. We enjoyed our visit." (Larry Ray Reed, 5/5)
- "Dark ,drunk, graffiti covered, heavy pouring barkeeps, diverse crowd of folks that don't want to be found.10/10. Love it. I never know how much I spent there so don't ask." (Bob Lahblah, 5/5)
- "On my list of best bars in America. Great beers on tap and the staff know how to make an unbelievable drink" (Jimmy Lolo (Dr. J), 5/5)
